headline: Weathered Expanse Recast Again as Nevish Line and Linn Mercy Shift
war_summary:
Fighting in the Weathered Expanse has recast that sector a second time in six hours. Where the last edition returned three Warden works, one Colonial and five unclaimed, it now stands seven Warden, none Colonial and two unclaimed, with forty-eight actions in the day though none in the past two hours.

The Nevish Line's seesaw continues: six Colonial works and two Warden now read five Colonial, one Warden and two unclaimed, with fifty-two actions in the day and nine in the past two hours, the latest entered at this packet's cutoff. Linn Mercy has gone the other way, its Colonial hold grown to eight works against two Warden and one unclaimed; the day's casualties there approach ten thousand Colonial and twelve thousand Warden. Callahan's Passage keeps all ten works Warden amid fresh activity at Crumbling Post, while Mooring County stands eleven Warden to one Colonial and Marban Hollow four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed. In Stlican Shelf a work at Briar passed to the Wardens within the past two hours. Stonecradle remains eight Colonial to one Warden, quiet since yesterday evening. In the Clahstra, casualties surged in the past hour without ground changing hands. Colonial holdings remain the greater across the map.
